title: Brand Color Constraint
description: Machine-readable rule constraining how a brand color may be used or paired. Use for accent-only colors, forbidden foreground/background combinations, and palette pairs that should never appear together.

color.description: Color role or value this constraint governs.

applies_to.description: Surfaces where this color may be used.

allowed_on.description: Backgrounds, surfaces, or color roles where this color is allowed.

forbidden_on.description: Backgrounds, surfaces, or color roles where this color is forbidden.

never_pair_with.description: Color roles or values that must not be paired with this color.

contexts.description: Channels or creative contexts where this constraint applies, such as digital, print, social, or ctv_end_card.

description.description: Human-readable rationale or source-language summary for the rule.
